items.title: The glue that binds a proton may be key to its identity
items.summary: Gluons do more than hold protons together. They may also help define the proton’s identity through a quantum property called baryon number.
items.zh: 结合质子的胶水可能是其身份的关键

items.title: Stars’ plasma spurts may be blocked by magnetic fields
items.summary: The sun frequently flings plasma into space, but sightings of such eruptions on other stars are rare. Magnetic fields could explain why.
items.zh: 恒星的等离子体喷发可能会被磁场阻挡

items.title: We've flown a radiation-blocking vest to the Moon and back, and it worked
items.summary: Let's shield the astronauts instead of the spacecraft.
items.zh: 我们已经将防辐射背心飞向月球并返回，它很有效

items.title: Researchers uncover hidden pore network within nuclear fuel
items.summary: New understanding of how nuclear fuel breaks down and changes in an operating nuclear reactor could help keep some reactors running longer, will inform the next generation of nuclear reactor fuel systems.
items.zh: 研究人员发现核燃料中隐藏的孔隙网络

items.title: These mammal ancestors birthed live young far earlier than thought
items.summary: Growth rings on a fossil bone suggest at least one mammal ancestor gave birth to live young rather than laying eggs 236 million years ago.
items.zh: 这些哺乳动物祖先的出生时间比想象的要早得多

items.title: Have physicists finally discovered glueballs? New evidence points to yes.
items.summary: “It’s the strongest evidence yet that particles dominated by a glueball component can exist in nature.”
items.zh: 物理学家终于发现了胶球吗？新证据表明是的。

items.title: MIT selected to lead new NSF materials research center
items.summary: The Materials Research Science and Engineering Center unites researchers across disciplines to develop technologies for medical imaging, sustainable metals production, and next-generation electronics.
items.zh: 麻省理工学院被选为 NSF 新材料研究中心的领导者

items.title: Astronomers discover a brand-new type of astrophysical object: A black hole star
items.summary: The mashup of a black hole and an enormous star has never been seen before and could explain the mysterious little red dots often found in deep-space images.
items.zh: 天文学家发现了一种全新的天体物理物体：黑洞星

items.title: Graduate Student Proves a Quantum Uncertainty Principle for Fractals
items.summary: The math, which combines chaos, quantum theory, and infinitely complex fractal structures, has been called a “foundational result.” The post Graduate Student Proves a Quantum Uncertainty Principle for Fractals first appeared on Quanta Magazine
items.zh: 研究生证明了分形的量子不确定性原理

items.title: Did poop enable the evolution of complex animals?
items.summary: In a recent study, evolution gets even messier than usual.
items.zh: 粪便是否促进了复杂动物的进化？

items.title: Tracking extreme heat by the hour makes climate change seem even worse
items.summary: Hot hours of summer could triple in the coming decades.
items.zh: 按小时追踪极端高温使气候变化看起来更加糟糕
